common.config_entries.announce_volume.de: The perceptual, relative or absolute volume level, used with the strategy for announcements.
common.config_entries.flow_mode.descript:
Enable "flow" mode where all queue tracks are sent as a continuous audio stream. 
Use for players that do not natively support gapless and/or crossfading or if the player has trouble transitioning between tracks.

See https://pictogrammers.com/library/mdi/.
common.config_entries.volume_normalizati: Enable volume normalisation based on the EBU-R128 standard without affecting dynamic range

Adjust average (perceived) loudness to this target level, default is -14 LUFS 

 **WARNING:** Setting the level too high may result in clipping!
